# Solid Hyperobjects: implementation and verification context

Owns solid-geometry cartridges and their manifests, source geometry, presets and provenance. Yantra4D owns the platform and render service; hyperobjects-spec owns shared schemas and validators. Soft pattern representations belong to soft-hyperobjects.

Navigation: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, GOVERNANCE.md, cartridge project.json files.
Read README.md and AGENTS.md before editing. Preserve the owning repository for
each API, schema, renderer and cartridge; consume shared code through explicit
package or submodule revisions. Follow CONTRIBUTING.md and GOVERNANCE.md where
present. Licensing, ranked-band ratification and new access require the
operator's existing decision process.

Test the capability changed: manifest checks establish schema conformance;
geometry checks need the actual kernel; package imports establish loading,
not modeling correctness. Keep absent prerequisites and skipped checks visible.
Use exact revision evidence for CI and deployments. Do not report queued or
running checks as successful or publish experimental geometry as verified.

Public/private handling: docs/PUBLIC_REPO_BOUNDARY.md. Never commit credentials,
private customer data or raw operational logs. Routine production operations
use Enclii; approved secret material uses its intake flow.
